question: Which of the following ores are primarily found in the Deccan Plateau region of India, contributing to its rich mineral resources?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron ore and Coal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Deccan Plateau**, a large triangular landmass south of the **Narmada River**, is one of the most mineral-rich regions in **India**. Its geological structure, consisting of ancient **crystalline rocks** and **volcanic basalt**, provides a vast repository of metallic and non-metallic minerals.
 
• **Iron ore** is found extensively in the **Dharwar rock system** of the plateau. Major deposits are concentrated in **Karnataka** (specifically the **Sandur-Hospet** and **Chikkamagaluru** districts), **Chhattisgarh** (the **Bailadila** range), and the **Ratnagiri** district of **Maharashtra**. These regions produce high-grade **Hematite** and **Magnetite**, which are essential for the **Iron and Steel industry**.
 
• **Coal** is primarily found in the **Gondwana formations** located along the eastern and southern edges of the plateau. Significant reserves are situated in the **Godavari Valley** (managed by **Singareni Collieries Company Limited** in **Telangana**), the **Wardha Valley** in **Maharashtra**, and the **Mahanadi Valley**. This coal is mostly **Bituminous** and serves as the primary fuel for **Thermal Power Plants** across the **country**.
 
• The presence of both **Iron ore** and **Coal** in and around the **Deccan Plateau** has facilitated the growth of heavy industrial clusters, making it the industrial backbone of southern and central **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bauxite and Manganese**: **Bauxite**, the primary ore for **Aluminium**, is found in the **Amarkantak** plateau and **Maikal hills**. **Manganese** is often found in association with iron ore in the **Nagpur-Bhandara** belt of **Maharashtra** and the **Shimoga** district of **Karnataka**. While significant, they are secondary to the massive iron and coal deposits in terms of industrial volume in this specific region.
 
• **Copper and Zinc**: These minerals are predominantly found in the **Aravalli Range** of **Rajasthan**. **Copper** is mined in **Khetri**, while **Zinc** is concentrated in the **Zawar** mines. The **Deccan Plateau** has very limited reserves of these base metals.
 
• **Gold and Diamond**: The **Deccan Plateau** is home to the famous **Kolar Gold Fields (KGF)** and **Hutti Gold Mines** in **Karnataka**. **Diamonds** were historically found in the **Golconda** region of **Andhra Pradesh** and are currently mined in **Panna**, **Madhya Pradesh**. However, these are precious minerals and do not constitute the bulk of the region's industrial mineral resources.
 
• **Geological Origin**: The **Deccan Traps** were formed by **fissure volcanic eruptions** nearly **66 million years ago** at the end of the **Cretaceous period**. This volcanic activity created the **Black Soil (Regur)**, which is highly suitable for **Cotton** cultivation, while the underlying older rocks hold the mineral wealth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Industrial Impact**: The availability of **Iron ore** in **Karnataka** and **Coal** in **Telangana** and **Maharashtra** has led to the establishment of major public sector undertakings like **Visvesvaraya Iron and Steel Plant** and various **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)** subsidiaries.
 
• **Economic Contribution**: **India** ranks **4th** globally in **Iron ore** production and **2nd** in **Coal** production as of **2023**. A substantial portion of this production originates from the states covering the **Deccan Plateau**.
 
• **Environmental Regulations**: Mining in these regions is governed by the **Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957**, and requires clearances from the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** to ensure sustainable extraction.
 
• **Export Hubs**: High-quality **Iron ore** from the **Deccan** region is exported to countries like **Japan** and **South Korea** through major ports such as **Mormugao** in **Goa** and **Visakhapatnam** in **Andhra Pradesh**.
